Job Details

Faculty positions available:

National Biomedical Imaging Center,

College of Future Technology, Peking University

The National Biomedical Imaging Center, College of Future Technology, Peking University invites outstanding global scholars for high-level faculty appointments. Positions are open until filled.

1. About NBIC

Established in 2020, the Peking University National Biomedical Imaging Center (NBIC), affiliated with the College of Future Technology at Peking University, constructs and operates the Multimodal Trans-Scale Biomedical Imaging Facility located in Huairou District, Beijing. Leveraging Peking University's interdisciplinary strengths in science, engineering and medicine, NBIC develops advanced imaging technologies and instrumentation to realize multi-dimensional digital and intelligent analysis of living organisms, ranging from molecular structures to whole organs.

NBIC hosts state-of-the-art platforms covering multimodal medical imaging, live-cell imaging, high-resolution molecular imaging, integrated data processing and model-animal research, enabling precise, real-time visualization of biological processes. Supported by these platforms, researchers can decipher mechanisms underlying complex diseases, accelerate drug discovery, and drive transformative advances in life sciences and medicine across the globe. For further information, please visit our website: https://nbic.pku.edu.cn/en/

2. Perspective Research Areas

We welcome applicants across all disciplines related to biomedical imaging and digital life, including imaging-based digitization and intelligent transformation of traditional life-science research, as well as disruptive biotechnologies featuring novel algorithms, instruments and probes for observation, imaging and modulation of biological systems. Rooted in distinctive interdisciplinary philosophy, NBIC intersects with a broad spectrum of research fields. Prospective candidates are encouraged to contact us for inquiries.

Priority research areas include, but are not limited to:

Imaging theory and system development
Probe and sensor development
Spatial omics based on imaging and complementary approaches
Big data, artificial intelligence and quantitative biology
Digital-life modeling
Innovative applications of imaging technologies in biomedical and clinical research

3. Positions Available

Faculty Track: Assistant Professor / Associate Professor / Associate Professor with Tenure / Full Professor with Tenure
Research Track: Research Assistant Professor / Research Associate Professor / Research Professor

4. Application Documents

Cover letter (specifying the position you apply for);
Comprehensive curriculum vitae (including personal information, education, professional experience, teaching-research statement and publication list), together with certificates of academic degrees and professional qualifications;
Five-year academic research plan;
Representative academic outputs;
Names and contact information of no fewer than three referees, normally including your PhD supervisor and postdoctoral host supervisor.

5. Contacts

Please submit all application documents to futec_recruit@pku.edu.cn. The email subject should follow the format: “Your Full Name + Application for National Biomedical Imaging Center”.
